description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different datasets: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names in the order Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, and is labeled “Datasets”. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents the accuracy values, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Two bars are present for each dataset, representing the accuracy of each model; the bars are colored light blue for MMAU and dark blue for MMAR. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 52% accuracy, while the MMAR bar reaches approximately 31%. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 61% accuracy, and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 35%. Finally, for Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 65% accuracy, and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 58%. The bars are grouped by dataset, with the MMAU bar appearing to the left of the MMAR bar for each dataset. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not indicate any specific sorting order.
